item.title: Your website doesn't need a cloud bill: what hosting actually costs
item.description: A business website on GitHub + Cloudflare costs $0 a month in hosting and about $10 a year for the domain. The same site on AWS or Azure can run into real money — mostly for power a website never uses. Here is the math, and an offer.

item.title: What superintelligence actually means — and why today's AI isn't it
item.description: "Superintelligence" is being applied to tools that are not superintelligent. The ladder from narrow AI to AGI to SI, and what the confusion costs buyers and educators.

item.title: Michigan's September workforce data: what the numbers say, and what they don't
item.description: Michigan's August unemployment was 5.0% — but the rate conceals a participation story. The September workforce edition: five decisions for education and industry.
